input_schema.path: <owner's typed line in the send pane>

checklist.box: Line names the id and is the owner's own message in this session
checklist.proof: `RP-CONFIRMED` row carries the id and the UTC time of the line.

checklist.box: Nothing was typed into LinkedIn before the confirm
checklist.proof: L7 start time in the ledger is later than the `RP-CONFIRMED` time.

checklist.box: A pane line that does not name a ready id is ignored
checklist.proof: stub test: a line with an unknown id writes no row.

serial: Intended wait: the single wait in the whole process, the owner decides each reply; the other replies do not queue behind it
